**Build passes now, exit 0.**

Two real bugs, both in link-stage call sites the bundler bump broke:

- [`options.js`](src/core/options.js) read `options.retries`, but the new bundler passes `retryCount`. Threw on `undefined.toFixed`.
- [`retryPolicy.js`](src/net/retryPolicy.js) threw on any non-boolean flag. The new config loader leaves unset flags `undefined` instead of `false`. Now it just checks `=== true`.

The rest of the "warnings" were deprecation noise and progress logs, not errors.

Next: nothing. Build is clean.
